report.summary: Chunk 3 of 3: defines helper functions _candidate_dirs, _match_file, _match_dir for resolving imports to file paths.

handoff.purpose: Defines helper functions for candidate file resolution in import resolution.

symbols.name: _candidate_dirs
symbols.note: Returns last directory segment(s) for package/dir-style imports (Go, QML).

symbols.name: _match_file
symbols.note: Matches a candidate file path against known set, preferring shallowest match.

symbols.name: _match_dir
symbols.note: Matches a directory segment to a file with appropriate extension (Go or QML).

claims.text: Last directory segment(s) for package/dir-style imports (Go, QML).
claims.why: For Go, returns the last segment of raw (after stripping trailing slash and splitting). For QML, also strips leading './'. This matches the docstring claim.

claims.text: prefer the shallowest (closest to root) match
claims.why: The loop selects best as the candidate with the shortest length (len(rel) < len(best)), which corresponds to the shallowest path.

observations.what: Function _candidate_dirs returns a list of strings; for Go and QML it returns one element; for other languages it returns empty list.
Function _match_file uses by_basename dict to find matches; prefers shallowest path by length, but does not consider path depth beyond string length.
Function _match_dir only matches files with .go or .qml extension, depending on lang parameter; for other languages returns None.
